feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: New revelations in Cornell sexual assault case spark outrage
entry.summary: The alleged victim of a 2024 gang rape at Cornell University clearly said in her police statement that she was sexually assaulted, her attorney told NPR — counter to what a prosecutor has claimed.

entry.title: Breweries adapt as tastes in beer change
entry.summary: The craft beer market is saturated and tastes are changing. Brewers are coming with innovative ways to attract customers.

entry.title: The family of Renee Good files lawsuits over her death during Minneapolis ICE raids
entry.summary: The fatal shooting of Renee Good by a federal immigration agent last January in Minneapolis set off a firestorm of protests around the U.S. Her family is speaking out for the first time.

entry.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

entry.title: Along U.S. Route 1, Maine voters worry about heating oil, gas and Canadian tariffs
entry.summary: Home to both Republican Sen. Susan Collins and Democratic candidate Troy Jackson, Maine's senate race has put rural Aroostook County in the spotlight.

entry.title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
entry.summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

entry.title: 'The 101 Plays Itself': This computer program treats the interstate into music
entry.summary: A Southern California man has created a system which translates cars passing on Interstates in California into soothing music.

entry.title: U.S. military forces formally left Iraq today, marking a new era
entry.summary: The U.S. military has been in Iraq for much of the past 35 years. A low-key ceremony Wednesday marked the formal departure of U.S. forces at a time when Iraq is still facing an uncertain future.

entry.title: How WNBA star Gabby Williams carries her $1 billion team
entry.summary: The Golden State Valkyries lead their playoff series 1-0 after the heroics of Gabby Williams. The former UConn star has one of the WNBA's latest expansion teams playing with incredible team chemistry.

entry.title: Hegseth speech leans on culture war flashpoints
entry.summary: Against the backdrop of an unpopular war in Iran, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave a "State of the Force" speech announcing new autonomous warfare initiatives and leaned on culture war flashpoints.
